blocks.text: Guildford Homes for Sale | Surrey BC MLS

parts.t: Guildford is North Surrey's shopping and transit hub east of City Centre, built around Guildford Town Centre and the Guildford Exchange. You'll find condos and townhomes near the mall and detached houses on the quieter streets around it. This page lists homes for sale across Guildford.

I've helped buyers and sellers since 2015 and I'm in the top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors. I grew up on a Langley farm and I live in Langley again, about a half-hour drive from the Guildford Exchange. Read my
Guildford neighbourhood guide
or compare all
North Surrey homes for sale
Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®

The City gave final approval to the Guildford Plan on October 30, 2023. It covers about 515 hectares in three areas: Guildford Centre, the Hawthorne District and the Headwaters District. If you're buying near 104 Avenue or the mall, read what the plan shows for the blocks around you.
Guildford Library is at 15105 105 Avenue, next to the Guildford Recreation Centre. Hawthorne Rotary Park on 144 Street and Bothwell Park on 168 Street are two of the bigger green spaces.
Guildford Park Secondary and Johnston Heights Secondary each have their own family of elementary schools here. Catchments follow the address; check the Surrey Schools School Locator.
There's no SkyTrain in Guildford. The Guildford Exchange is the hub, with the R1 RapidBus and routes such as the 320, 335 and 501.

Guildford suits buyers who want shops, the library, the rec centre and frequent buses within reach, whether that's from a condo near the mall or a house a few blocks away. It's also a good middle ground for people who work in both Surrey and the Tri-Cities, with Highway 1 close by.
It may suit you less if you want a SkyTrain stop at your door. The R1 RapidBus connects you, but it's a bus ride.

Guildford buyers range from first-time condo buyers to families looking for a house with a suite. I'll help you figure out which group is most likely to buy your home and what they'll want to see. For strata sellers, ordering the Form B early saves time once you have an offer.

Tell me whether you're after a condo, townhome or house and how close to the Exchange you'd like to be. I'll send you listings that fit, and I'll point out the ones near blocks the Guildford Plan is likely to change.
Condo and townhome buyers should read the strata documents closely. My
Guildford condos
and
Guildford townhomes
pages list just those home types.
